main.description: Get the authenticated user's profile settings. Returns defaults if no profile exists.

uri.description: Profile record URI (absent if no profile configured)

cid.description: Profile record CID (absent if no profile configured)

profile.description: The profile record data (defaults if not configured)

hasProfile.description: Whether the user has saved a profile record

readyForPayment.description: Whether the user's payment account is set up and enabled
